title: genista humilis
intro: Genista humilis, commonly known as Dwarf Bird's Foot, is a low-growing, deciduous shrub belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Genista humilis include its ability to treat digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, and its use as an antiseptic to aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Genista humilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
